open_leads.note: A news site says it was added on 25 Nov 2026; CyberView's KEV records show no entry and CISA's advisory says no known exploitation. Confirm against the CISA catalog; if listed, raise priority to immediate and update exploitation_status.

open_leads.title: Is CVE-2026-125812 in CISA KEV?

notes: Two analyses written; analyst check reports both valid. Danfoss priority set to urgent, not immediate, because neither exploitation of this specific CVE nor public exploit code is confirmed, although the product family is under active attack. Patchstack's WP Rocket rule is noted as a paid service. No instructions were found in page text. A direct download of the CISA KEV feed was not permitted in this environment.
